evidence_slice: MHCLG Planning Data entity 560009 identifies Ebbsfleet Development Corporation in the Development corporation boundary dataset and links the Ebbsfleet Development Corporation (Area and Constitution) Order 2015. The Order came into force on 20 April 2015 and designates the Ebbsfleet urban development area. Ebbsfleet Development Corporation's current official website states that it was established in 2015 to speed delivery of up to 15,000 homes, acts as planning authority for the Urban Regeneration Area, and reports that over 5,000 homes are complete.
